ModMetaData.name: Pick Up And Haul (Optimized)
ModMetaData.author: Mehni (Optimized by D3athAn63l)
ModMetaData.description:
"Greatest hauling mod ever" - Chicken Plucker
This is an optimized fork of Pick Up And Haul for RimWorld 1.6.
⚠️ INCOMPATIBLE WITH ORIGINAL MOD ⚠️ Do NOT enable both "Pick Up And Haul" (by Mehni) and this optimized version at the same time. They will conflict.
Functionality: Colonists will gather stuff in their inventory, then haul it all to a stockpile. This hauling mod greatly increases hauling efficiency because pawns can carry more than one item at a time.
Optimizations in this fork: • Per-map caching to prevent cross-map invalidation • try/finally cleanup for temporary state • Reduced LINQ allocations in hot paths • Null safety improvements • Proper build system with Krafs.Publicizer
Original mod by Mehni. Optimizations by D3athAn63l.
